title: Weakly convergent subsequence under local mass bounds (Banach–Alaoglu step of 2.15)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open, and let T : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U n satisfy sup_q M_W(T_q) < ∞ for every W with CompactlyContainedOpen W U. Then there are a strictly increasing φ : ℕ → ℕ and T₀ ∈ GeometricCurrentOn U n such that T_{φ(q)} ⇀ T₀ in U, i.e. T_{φ(q)}(ω) → T₀(ω) for every ω ∈ TestFormOn U n (WeaklyConvergesOn (fun q => T (φ q)) T₀).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ T : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U n, (∀ W, CompactlyContainedOpen W U → (⨆ q, (T q).massOn W) < ∞) → ∃ (φ : ℕ → ℕ) (T₀ : GeometricCurrentOn U n), StrictMono φ ∧ WeaklyConvergesOn (fun q => T (φ q)) T₀
